A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same ConceptCarve study, with all 18 pages and Appendices A–F available. Text and rendered-page comparisons confirm identical substantive content; only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp differs.

before.justification: v1 reports original reranking experiments in Table 2, end-to-end retrieval experiments in Table 3, human annotation results in Appendix A, and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original retrieval experiments, human annotation results, and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: The Characterizer and Retriever procedures, concept induction, promoted/demoted concepts, scoring equations, and weighting scheme are identical in Section 4 and Appendix B.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Reddit data, six communities, 30 moral-foundation-based trends, and dataset-informed reranking and end-to-end retrieval tasks. Appendix A's dataset coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains BM25, ColBERT, ANCE, RepLLaMA, Query2Doc + ColBERT, MultiQuery + ColBERT, and ENVISION ONLY. Table 3 retains the same ColBERT and ConceptCarve comparisons.

E3.justification: The 180 reranking sets of 2,000 posts, evaluation metrics, tree configurations, and end-to-end evaluation on 24 trend-community pairs are unchanged. The annotation and evaluation procedures also match.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same ENVISION ONLY and depth comparisons, demoted-concept ablation in Table 3, qualitative analyses in Figures 5 and 13–14, and branching-factor/grounding sensitivity analysis in Figure 15.

E5.justification: Figure 4's plotted error bars and the accompanying statistical documentation are identical. No repeated-run, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or statistical-test information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings match. For example, Table 2 reports MAP@500 of 14.33 for ConceptCarve at depth 2 and 11.37 for Query2Doc + ColBERT in both versions. Appendix results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The task definitions in Section 3.1, Equations 1–3, weighting formulation in Appendix B, and cost derivations in Appendix F are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about retrieval performance, domain adaptation, interpretability, scalability, and the proposed dataset.

C2.justification: The explanations of demoted concepts, community differences, and computational tradeoffs are unchanged. Both versions retain the same limitations concerning Reddit-only coverage and potential bias from LLM annotation.

D1.justification: The prompts, model/checkpoint information, hyperparameters, and implementation descriptions in Appendices B–D are identical. The dataset release link and its target also match.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the complete bibliography are identical, preserving the same citations and positioning relative to query expansion, domain adaptation, and concept-based analysis.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv:2504.07228v1 dated 9 April 2025 to v2 dated 22 May 2025. All manuscript prose, headings, terminology, and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, and page layout are unchanged. Pages 2–18 render identically; page 1 differs only in the text of the arXiv margin stamp.

improvement.justification: The later PDF changes only the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, limitations, and visual presentation are otherwise identical, including the appendices, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
